Requirement: Obtain representative operational data with documented sensor definitions, failure labels, and equipment history.
Exit_Criterion: Qualified engineers approve data provenance and intended analytical use.

Requirement: Validate sensor calibration, missing-data handling, feature engineering, and operating-condition normalization.
Exit_Criterion: Documented data-quality tests and repeatable feature-generation results.

Requirement: Test unseen engine histories, prediction bias, uncertainty calibration, and failure-stage performance.
Exit_Criterion: Predefined performance and safety-related acceptance criteria are satisfied.

Requirement: Evaluate model limitations, proposed alert rules, failure consequences, and approved maintenance procedures.
Exit_Criterion: Qualified engineering and maintenance stakeholders approve the proposed scope.

Requirement: Run a monitored shadow-mode pilot without changing actual maintenance decisions or approved intervals.
Exit_Criterion: Pilot performance, false alarms, missed detections, and drift are reviewed.

Requirement: Complete applicable safety, cybersecurity, configuration, training, and maintenance approval processes.
Exit_Criterion: Formal authorization is documented before any operational integration.
